rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for the act of engraving characters and for the lettering physically engraved on an object.

example.english: The inscription on this wooden plaque is really nice.
example.traditional: 呢塊木牌上面嘅刻字幾靚。
example.jyutping: ni1 faai3 muk6 paai4 soeng6 min6 ge3 haak1 zi6 gei2 leng3

rows.note: Use this for a formal named inscription, especially one on a monument, plaque, or gravestone, rather than for the act of engraving.

example.english: The inscription on this monument is very solemn.
example.traditional: 呢塊紀念碑嘅銘文寫得好莊嚴。
example.jyutping: ni1 faai3 gei2 nim6 bei1 ge3 ming4 man4 se2 dak1 hou2 zong1 jim4
